items.title: Santo Pecora Interview, 1972-11-09
items.q: I worked with Will Osborne. ... I made a picture of Blue's of the Night with Will Osborne.

ctx.x: You said you worked with Buddy Rogers. Did you ever know Will Osborne? Didn't he ever?
I worked with Will Osborne. Yeah, who was he? I made a picture of Blue's of the Night with Will Osborne. Oh, with that band, I see.
Yeah. Did you record with Buddy Rogers and Benny Murroff and Will Osborne?
